scope: Checked-in cheyenne-2026-transcripts catalog and Markdown files only; excludes external archive repositories and uncollected city records.

rules.unique_document_contents: Distinct SHA-256 hashes among transcript files referenced by catalog entries; identical content counts once.
rules.stored_markdown_files: Every Markdown file under cheyenne-2026-transcripts, including unreferenced variants; this is not a count of all stored files or attachments.
rules.searchable_catalog_documents: Referenced Markdown files with non-empty extracted text. This does not establish that an associated PDF or source is searchable.
rules.caption_transcripts: Searchable transcript files in this archive. Transcript is not minutes.
rules.auto_generated_caption_transcripts: Catalogued searchable transcripts whose Markdown source header explicitly labels the captions auto-generated.
rules.other_or_unlabeled_caption_sources: Caption transcripts whose header does not explicitly say auto-generated; this does not prove captions were human-created.
rules.audio_checked_excerpts: Zero recorded excerpt-level audio checks in this repository's current verification register; absence of a check record is not proof no one listened.
rules.original_source_checks: Zero documented comparisons against original publisher files in the current verification register.
rules.image_review_or_ocr_pending: Not measured: this repository's checked-in 2026 transcript catalog does not include a complete inventory of PDF page images or a linked page-level extraction audit queue.

verification_note: A successful site build or deployment is not evidence that new government records were collected or verified.
